eobiont.m: A hypothetical primordial life-form or chemical precursor to a living organism.

eobionts.m: More than one eobiont. eobiont: a hypothetical primordial life-form or chemical precursor to a living organism.

eosine.m: Another spelling of eosin. eosin: a red fluorescent dye resulting from the action of bromine on fluorescein; used in cosmetics and as a biological stain for studying cell structures.

eosinophilous.m: Having an affinity for dyes such as eosin.
